 Order

13.05.2024 Heard Mr. B. Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioner; Ms. R. Bora, learned Standing Counsel, NHAI and NHIDCL for the respondent nos. 1 - 4; and Mr. S. Baruah, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 5 - 7.

The petitioner has approached this Court with a grievance that the respondent authorities have not yet brought the process of assessment of the building and tea factory which have already been acquired under the National Highways Act, 1965 in connection with National Highway no. 37, to its logical conclusion by finally determining the amount of Page No.# 3/3 compensation.
Issue notice, returnable in 4 [four] weeks.
